chapter: Early bands and New Orleans musicians
title: Dan Hughes's band: Ballet Rite and Clem Camp
summary: They recall the drummer and clarinetist of Dan Hughes's band, with Loyacano on trombone and his brother Bud on bass horn.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well Steve Woodrow was a drummer with a triangle. That's right.

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
blocks.x: He was with Dan Hughes too. Huh?

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
blocks.x: No, he wasn't with Hughes. What you played around the city, he didn't play in that band?

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
blocks.x: Oh that's right, Ballet Rite was the drummer.
Uh, we were talking about Dan Hughes. Ballet Rite was the drummer then?
Yeah, Ballet Rite played the drummer.
And who else would be in the band? Do you remember the other?

No, I don't remember the other members of the band. All I remember was Dan Hughes and uh, Clem Camp. He had a patchy over his eye. He was the clarinet player. Hughes had one eye and Clem Camp had a patchy over his eye. He was the clarinet player.
Is he still around Clem Camp?
No, I don't know. I don't know whether he's still living or not. I played trombone. And uh, Ballet Rite played drums. My brother played bass horn. And uh, that was all.
